articleTitle: A Study on Fault Diagnosis of Valve Cooling Equipment Based on Parallel Voiceprint Recognition Algorithm of AMFCC and DNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Aiming at the lack of online monitoring means for valve cooling equipment, its internal faults often rely on the judgment of operation and maintenance experience, the degree of digital operation and maintenance is low and other problems. This article proposes the use of AMFCC (Attention Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficient) and DNN parallel algorithms to recognize and determine the operating status of valve cooling equipment by utilizing the voiceprint information generated during operation. Firstly, the sound data of the valve cooling equipment under different working conditions are collected and pre-processed by frame splitting and window adding. Then, by adding attention mechanism to the Mel cepstral coefficient (MFCC) feature extraction method, an AMFCC algorithm model is built to extract voiceprint features from the data. Finally, TensorFlow is used to process the data in parallel and combined with deep neural network (DNN) for acoustic feature recognition to realize the fault diagnosis of valve-cooled equipment. The research results indicate that the AMFCC and DNN algorithm models have F1 scores of over 90% for identifying five types of faults in valve cooling equipment through voiceprint data, which is consistent with the characteristic of smooth changes in sound energy of valve cooling equipment.

articleTitle: Research method of insulator burst fault identification based on self-attention YOLOv4
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The integrity of the insulator on the transmission line directly affects the safety and reliability of the transmission. In this paper, deep learning method is used to study the problem of insulator image recognition extraction and defect detection. Due to the limitation of the number of model parameters, the existing models cannot directly use high-resolution images, and the recognition accuracy has great room for improvement. In order to solve this problem, a new method of insulator burst fault identification based on self-attentional YOLOv4 is proposed by combining self-attentional YOLO with YOLO. Compared to other models of this type, Transformer’s self-attention mechanism can capture long distance dependencies in a sequence. Its model is able to take into account information that is far apart in the sequence to make more accurate predictions. Compared with the traditional YOLOv4 model, it can be found that the proposed insulator burst fault identification model can identify the insulation and its burst fault accurately and quickly

articleTitle: Pitfalls and Improvements Analysis of closing permission and loss of voltage criterion Logic in Backup Automatic Switch
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Backup Automatic Switch ensures uninterrupted power supply by quickly putting in a standby power supply when the main power supply is out of operation due to a fault. Backup Automatic Switch in the process of operation by a variety of circumstances will be affected by the refusal to operate or false activation of the situation. This paper analyses the deficiencies in the logic of the closing permission and loss of voltage criterion of the Backup Automatic Switch, and puts forward corresponding improvement measures to effectively improve the success rate of the power supply Backup Automatic Switch action, and protect the normal operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Research on Insulation Coordination Design for ±600kV Bipolar HVDC Transmission Line with Dedicated Metallic Return in Chile
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The paper developed a new insulation coordination design method to create a tower head electrical design, which meets the requirements of environmental conditions for the first ±600kV HVDC Kimal Lo Aguirre (KILO) project in Chile. Based on the results of the overvoltage study, and considering the local Chilean climate and pollution research results, combined with the mature design and operational experience of ±800kV transmission lines in China, specific recommendations were made for the selection of insulators for the pole conductors and Dedicated Metallic Return (DMR). According to the relevant standards such as the current IEC standards, Cigre standards, and Chilean regulations, the electrical clearances for the pole conductors and DMR of the ±600kV HVDC project were calculated. By integrating the recommended insulator types and electrical clearance values, typical tower head electrical design suitable for the ±600kV HVDC transmission project with DMR was developed.

articleTitle: Condition Assessment and Maintenance Strategy of Flexible DC Distribution Equipment Based on Improved FMEA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Flexible DC distribution technology is a key supporting technology for the flexible transformation of distribution networks. Several demonstration projects of flexible DC distribution networks have been put into operation domestically. However, the condition assessment methods and maintenance strategies for flexible DC distribution equipment are not yet established, leading to challenges such as complex maintenance operations, high workload, and low levels of precision. To address these issues, this paper proposes a condition assessment method for flexible DC distribution equipment based on improved Failure Mode and Effect Analysis (FMEA). First, the potential failure mechanisms and condition indicators of key components of flexible DC distribution equipment are analyzed, and critical state variables are identified. Evaluation criteria for failure degree, importance, and detection rate of these state variables are then developed to achieve quantitative condition assessment of the equipment. Based on the assessment results, differentiated maintenance and operation strategies are formulated. Finally, the method is validated through an analysis of a converter as an example. This approach is also applicable to other flexible DC distribution equipment and can enhance maintenance efficiency and precision.

articleTitle: Analysis of anonymous phase grounding fault and tripping strategy optimization for double-circuit transmission lines on the same tower
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The fault detection technology and tripping strategy for single circuit high-voltage transmission lines of 220 kV and above have gradually matured, but for the particularity of faults in double-circuit transmission lines, further research is needed on fault characteristics and detection methods. In this article, a fault analysis is conducted on double-circuit transmission lines with anonymous phase grounding fault, to determine the failure mode and the entire process of fault development. At the same time, a detailed analysis of the action behaviour of the phase selector was conducted based on the principle of relay protection, and it was pointed out that for the faults of double circuit transmission lines on the same tower, the distance phase selector may not be able to correctly distinguish the fault phase. In addition, in response to the shortcomings of tripping two single-circuit transmission lines due to double-circuit transmission line faults, this article proposes a tripping strategy suitable for cross-country faults in double-circuit transmission lines, which can further improve the stability of power system.

articleTitle: A new protection scheme for HVDC transmission lines based on discrete-domain Digital Filter modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: To solve the problem of insufficient tolerance of fault resistance in transmission line protection under remote faults, a single-ended protection scheme for HVDC systems based on discrete domain Digital Filter model is proposed. Through detailed analysis of the frequency characteristics of internal and external faults, it can be concluded that the boundary of HVDC lines can cause differences in the characteristics between internal and external faults. Therefore, this paper analyzes the frequency domain characteristics of the DC boundary in detail, and introduces a new type of Digital Filter to extract the high-frequency component of transient voltage. The algorithm is simple, and it does not rely on time-frequency analysis methods to obtain the frequency component of fault traveling wave. The simulation results show that the scheme can reliably identify internal and external faults, has strong ability to withstand fault resistance, and has high sensitivity and selectivity.

articleTitle: A Fast Single-Ended Protection Scheme for DC Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Emerging technologies in decentralized solar power generation and electric vehicle infrastructure present an optimistic perspective for flexible DC distribution networks. During the fault, the current in the line increases rapidly and quickly reaches the maximum current that the DC circuit breaker can interrupt. Therefore, the reliable operation of DC distribution networks heavily relies on a fast fault detection method. This paper utilizes magnetic rings as line boundaries and proposes a fast single-end protection method in the frequency domain. First, the characteristics of transient voltage under the influence of magnetic rings are analyzed. Next, based on these voltage characteristics, a protection criterion using the ratio of high-frequency (HF) to low-frequency (LF) energy is proposed, along with a complete protection scheme. Numerical simulations validate that faults can be recognized quickly and accurately by the proposed method.

articleTitle: An AC/DC loss allocation method considering three-terminal flexible direct current under power market environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The increase of the types of DC transmission line pose a greater challenge to the problem of AC/DC network loss allocation under the power market environment. In this paper, marginal loss coefficient method is extended based on the idea of sensitivity analysis, and then a network loss allocation method for AC-DC hybrid system suitable for power market is proposed. First of all, formulation of network loss is improved. Then the chain derivative relationship is solved based on AC/DC operating equations. Finally, marginal loss coefficient is solved and network loss calculation is performed. simulation of IEEE-39 AC/DC hybrid system verifies the accuracy of the model solution, the effectiveness of the model in the electricity market environment, and the applicability in large-scale system.

articleTitle: DC Terminal Impedance Modeling and Stability Analysis for VSG-Controlled Grid-Connected Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: As a kind of grid-forming control method that can effectively provide virtual inertia for the power grid, the virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control has received increasing attention in recent years. However, the VSG control will extract energy from the DC side during a grid frequency drop, which brings a burden on the stability of the DC side of a VSG. To address this problem, this paper establishes a fully analytical small-signal model of the VSG DC terminal impedance, incorporating both the inertia mechanism and the DC side dynamics. The accuracy of the model is validated through comparison with the sweep frequency results of the simulation. Finally, the Nyquist criterion is employed to analyze the DC stability of the VSG, and the simulation results match well with the theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Diagnostic study of insulation defects in zero-carbon DC system based on GRU-ATT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The current insulation defect detection method of DC system has problems such as complicated calculation and large error.For this reason, this paper proposes a GRU-ATT based insulation defect diagnosis method for DC systems based on the Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) model, combined with the attention mechanism (ATT).First, the simulation model of DC system is built to simulate the insulation defects of each branch and collect the current signals; then the collected signals are subjected to noise reduction and feature extraction, and the feature data are downscaled by Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to generate new feature vectors; Finally, based on the GRU-ATT neural network model, three different neural network models are established to conduct comparative experiments for insulation defect diagnosis using the new feature vectors as input data.The experiments show that the identification accuracy of insulation defects in all branches using the GRU-ATT model reaches more than 96.77%.

articleTitle: Study of key operation and maintenance parameters of optical measurement system based on purely optical current transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Based on the operation and maintenance experience of pure optical current transformer in the field application of a domestic ultra-high voltage converter station, this paper elaborates the operation principle of the optical measurement system applied in the engineering field, researches the key state quantities affecting the accuracy and reliability of the optical measurement system, and proposes that the relative optical power should be used as the core key parameter, and the absolute optical power, the temperature of the sensor head, the temperature of the optical module, and the half-wave voltage should be used as the auxiliary parameter, so that the optical measurement system can be realized as a stable operation monitoring and early warning configuration. The relative optical power is proposed as the core key parameter, and the absolute optical power, sensing head temperature, optical module temperature, and half-wave voltage are proposed as auxiliary parameters, so as to realize a monitoring and early warning configuration for the stable operation of optical measurement system. The role of key parameters and reliable operation range are clarified, and data analysis and processing are carried out through the system to realize real-time monitoring of key state quantities.

articleTitle: Research on the Inversion of Measured Shielding Lightning Waveforms on 500 kV Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: In this paper, the consistency in time, space and amplitude was confirmed by obtaining the lightning current waveform data in the recorded waveform of the distributed fault location system installed on the 500 kV transmission line and comparing it with the query results of the lightning location system. Based on the actual line parameters and considering the impact corona effect during lightning strikes, this paper builds a PSCAD transmission line simulation model, inverts and calculates the lightning current waveforms, and ensures that the deviation between the simulated waveforms and the measured waveforms is within 10%. And accordingly proposed the characteristic parameter range of the lightning current waveform, which provides a scientific basis and technical support for the lightning protection of transmission lines.

articleTitle: Optimization of Operating Frequency for Flexible Low-Frequency Transmission Systems Considering Multiple Variables
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Flexible low-frequency transmission technology offers notable economic benefits for offshore wind power transmission in deep and remote sea areas. The selection of system operating frequency is the key to constructing a flexible low-frequency transmission system. Therefore, this paper studies optimal frequency selection for flexible low-frequency transmission systems. First, the impact caused by frequency changes on the cost of key components in flexible low-frequency transmission systems is analyzed. Then, the key equipment’s loss in flexible low-frequency transmission system is calculated, and the discounted electrovalency of the losses is computed based on the discounted cash flow model. Finally, the costs of flexible low-frequency transmission systems at different frequencies, typical capacities, and typical distances are calculated.

articleTitle: Linear Quadratic Optimal Control of MMCSTATCOM with Stationary Frame under Asymmetric Fault in AC Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Static synchronous compensator based on modular multilevel converter (MMC-STATCOM) can achieve dynamic reactive power output and voltage support when an AC grid fault occurs. Aiming at the problem that the control algorithm is too cumbersome due to the positive and negative sequence AC components when asymmetrical faults occur in the grid, an MMC-STATCOM AC fault ride-through algorithm based on the stationary frame is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a phase-locked loop is used to obtain the phase of the positive sequence component of the grid voltage. Then, the dynamic reactive current reference value is transferred into the two-phase stationary frame. In order to address the problems of the PI regulator not being able to achieve the sinusoidal component tracking with a zero error, the quasi proportional-integral-resonant control algorithm based on the linear quadratic optimal control state feedback is proposed to achieve the fast tunning of multiple control parameters. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the control strategy proposed in this paper are verified under a simulation test system.

articleTitle: Research on GIS basin insulator performance and two-stage curing method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: In order to optimize the basin insulator process and improve the material properties, a two-stage curing process with different temperatures was designed. The sample of basin insulator was prepared according to the process, and the thermal, mechanical and electrical properties of the material were tested, including thermogravimetric analysis, Vica softening temperature, density, tensile property, bending property, compression property, dielectric constant, resistivity, etc. The results show that the best two-stage curing process is $120^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ curing for $\mathbf{8 h}+155^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ curing for 10 h.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Multi-terminal Blocking-type MMC Flexible DC System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Reliability and economy are the key to realize the large-scale and intensive development of offshore wind power. The hybrid converter valve based on improved series double sub-modules has better economy in scenarios such as large-scale offshore wind power grid connection. In this paper, the technical economy of hybrid MMC converter valve based on improved series double sub-module and half-bridge sub-module is analyzed. Compared with other MMC converter valves with DC fault clearing ability, the hybrid MMC converter valve based on improved series double sub-modules and half-bridge sub-modules is more economical, and has stronger DC fault clearing ability, and the system has high reliability.

articleTitle: Study of defects based on simulation of action currents of EM multi-column parallel arresters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The metallic return arrester(shortened as EM arrester) often adopts a multi-column parallel structure. The uneven current coefficient reflects its current sharing characteristics, affecting overall performance. This paper first simulates and analyzes the action characteristics of the EM arrester under typical fault conditions. As the deteriorated column volt-ampere characteristics decrease, the uneven current coefficient increases, accompanied by increases in the deteriorated column’s amplitude, head/tail slope, and absorbed energy. The head time remains stable, while the tail time varies irregularly. Based on the correlation analysis, the amplitude, head/tail slope, and absorbed energy are selected as the feature parameters, and their respective scale factor thresholds are calculated to be 1.098, 1.098, 1.099, and 1.101, respectively. The thresholds provide a theoretical basis for the EM arrester’s online monitoring and early warning, which is valuable for ensuring equipment safety and enhancing system operation stability.

articleTitle: 10kV SiC MOSFET Module for Traction Converter Application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The use of silicon carbide (SiC) MOSFET power modules offers benefits such as rapid switching, excellent thermal conductivity, and minimal losses, supporting the advancement of energy-efficient, highly reliable high-power locomotive traction converters. In this paper, a $10 \mathrm{kV} / 125 \mathrm{~A}$ halfbridge high-voltage silicon carbide MOSFET power module for traction drive system is designed and its electrical properties are investigated. A test circuit has been built for a double-pulse simulation to evaluate the dynamic and static capabilities of the module. It has been tested in various physical simulations, such as electromagnetic, thermal, and mechanical analyses, confirming its suitability for use in traction converters and other high-voltage applications.

articleTitle: A Coordinated Strategy to Mitigate DC Voltage Rise in MMC-HVDC Systems with Offshore Wind Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: For systems where Off-shore Wind Farms (OWFs) supply power to the AC grid through Voltage Source Converter based High Voltage DC (MMC-HVDC) transmission, a short circuit fault on the AC side can lead to catastrophic overvoltage events on the DC side. To enhance the Fault Ride Through (FRT) capability, the current mainstream technical measures to suppress DC overvoltage primarily include two methods: installing DC dissipation devices such as Dynamic Breaking System (DBS) and controlling the reduction of active power output from wind turbines during faults. This paper proposes a coordinated control strategy to mitigate DC voltage rise caused by faults in an MMC-HVDC system integrated with offshore wind farms (OWFs), wherein a classical DBS is selected as the DC dissipation device, and simultaneously, the output active power of the wind turbines is controlled without communication delay. This approach achieves an enhancement in system FRT capability with low cost and high efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on key technology of N-phase interleaved parallel DC/DC converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The research and application of interleaved parallel high-capacity DC/DC converters have become increasingly important as core equipment for improving energy conversion efficiency and system stability. In response to the lack of parameter design methods for N -phase interleaved parallel DC/DC converters, this article firstly explains the working principle of interleaved parallel DC/DC converters. Then, the core parameter calculation method for N-phase interleaved parallel DC/DC converters is derived. Finally, in response to the specific requirements of a certain project, the parameter design of a 630 kW three-phase interleaved parallel DC/DC converter is completed and simulated based on the proposed parameter design method. The results show that the current ripple, voltage ripple and other parameters obtained based on the proposed method are basically consistent with the simulation results, which verifies the accuracy of the proposed parameter design method and provides reference for the design of subsequent high-capacity interleaved parallel DC/DC converter products.

articleTitle: An MMC optimal balancing control strategy based on SMs’ Capacitor Voltage Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: For the half-bridge modular multilevel converter (MMC), we proposes a new kind voltage optimized balance method to reduce the sub-modules’(SMs’) switching frequency according to the law of SMs’ capacitor voltage change during MMC operation. Firstly, the MMC operation principle is analysed to clarify the limitation of the SMs’ capacitance voltage fluctuation and the optimization objectives such as switching frequency and switching loss. Secondly, according to the SMs’ capacitance voltage level, the SMs are classified into low, middle and high categories, when the bridge arm current is positive, the SMs of the high voltage category should be removal as far as possible, the SMs of the middle voltage category are adopted as much as possible to maintain the original status, and the SMs of the low voltage category are adopted as much as possible to put in which can reduce the switching frequency. Finally, based on the MMC simulation model which is built in MATLAB, the correctness and effectiveness of the strategy introduced in this paper are verified.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis and Upgradation of Protections for HVDC Project with Common Grounding Electrode
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: As an essential part of HVDC project, the grounding electrode provides path for the ground current and unbalanced current. HVDC projects in Southeastern China usually adopt the method of common grounding electrode, where two or more HVDC projects are connected to the same grounding electrode. A potential risk is that the common grounding site could provide the path and introduce ground current and unbalanced current to the other HVDC converter station, causing the protection system to respond unexpectedly. This paper carried out the verification through PSCAD simulation and provide protection upgradation method in a common-grounding HVDC system.

articleTitle: A digital converter station monitoring data fusion method for full-stop fault discrimination
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: As modern power systems evolve, high-voltage direct current (HVDC) technology has emerged as the preferred solution for transmitting power over long distances and large capacities. The performance of converter stations, which are central to HVDC systems, has a direct impact on the stability and reliability of the entire transmission network. Full-stop faults, where the converter station completely ceases operation, are particularly severe and can lead to widespread power outages, causing significant economic losses and social impacts. This study proposes a digital converter station monitoring data fusion method for full-stop fault discrimination. By integrating data from various sensors through Bayesian inference, the proposed method enhances the accuracy and reliability of fault detection. The model utilizes Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM), and Attention mechanisms to process and analyze sensor data, demonstrating significant improvements in classification performance indicators such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score after data fusion. The results underscore the critical role of data fusion in improving fault detection and ensuring the stable operation of power systems.

articleTitle: Small-Signal Stability Analysis of Grid-Tied GFL/GFM VSCs System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Due to the increasing penetration of renewable energy, the system’s short circuit ratio (SCR) will decrease, and the risk of system instability will increase. Therefore, it is necessary to incorporate grid-forming (GFM) converters to enhance system stability. Thus, a small-signal model of the grid-tied grid-following/grid-forming voltage source converters (VSCs) system is established, and the system’s steady-state operating point and small-signal stability are analyzed. It is concluded that GFM converters can provide voltage support for the system and improve its small-signal stability. The simulation model result in Simulink verifies the analysis.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Inertia and Damping Control of VSG with Four-leg inverter for Photovoltaics-Storage Grid Connected System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Virtual synchronous generator (VSG) is a practical method to solve stability problems related to the growth of photovoltaic (PV) cells. However, when using traditional topology and control strategies, the system’s anti-interference ability is weak. Proposed adaptive inertia and damping control for four bridge VSG inverters to improve system strength. The topology and control strategies of photovoltaics-storage grid connected system is presented. The results indicate that even with the addition of unbalanced charges, the output voltage can remain balanced. In addition, based on the angular frequency fluctuation curve of the synchronous generator (SG), VSG adaptive inertia and damping control is proposed to enhance system stability and performance. The results indicate that compared with traditional management strategies, the system’s dynamic response has been improved and redundancy has been reduced. Finally, MATLAB/Simulink is used; the adaptive inertia and damping control of VSG with four-leg inverter for photovoltaics-storage grid connected system is verified by simulation and results.

articleTitle: Study on Surge Arrester Impulse Stress in a 500kV AC Switch Yard Under Multiple Lightning Strikes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Surge arresters are the primary equipment for overvoltage protection, and the effective coordination among the protective characteristics of surge arresters, system overvoltage characteristics, and equipment insulation characteristics is fundamental to the safe and stable operation of the system. In this paper, a model of the AC side lines of a converter station was established to study and analyze the magnitude of electrical stress and the waveform of impulse current experienced by surge arresters when multiple lightning strokes occur on the AC side conductors of the converter station. The applicability of the current surge arrester selection under conditions of multiple lightning invasion waves was verified, and a systematic analysis was conducted to compare the electrical stress on surge arresters under multiple lightning strikes with that under a single lightning strike.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Dispersion of Insulator U50% Considering the Influence of Waveform and Altitude
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of standard and short-tail impulse waves on the discharge voltage of insulators at different altitudes. Through experiments conducted in both plain and high-altitude regions, the U50% discharge voltage was recorded using the up-and-down method, and the normality of the discharge voltage was assessed by the Shapiro-Wilk test. The dispersion of discharge voltage under various conditions was then analyzed. The study finds a strong linear relationship between the dry arc distance and the $\boldsymbol{U}_{50 \%}$ discharge voltage under standard wave impulses. In high-altitude regions, the normality rate of positive polarity standard waves ($\mathbf{4 5 . 4 5 \%}$) is higher than that of positive polarity short-tail waves. Additionally, the normality rate in plain regions (54.55%) exceeds that in high-altitude regions. The results demonstrate that discharge voltage dispersion is greater at high altitudes and under short-tail wave impulses. These findings contribute to a deeper understanding of the discharge processes of insulators in different environments and conditions, and provide crucial data support for the lightning protection design of transmission lines.

articleTitle: Research and application of heat loss calculation and analysis method in the design process of conductivity sensors for high-voltage direct current converter valves
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Conductivity is a fundamental property of electrolyte solutions and plays a key role in many applications. Measuring water conductivity with conductivity sensors facilitates the assessment of the solubility of trace salts. This process sheds light on the dynamics of ion interactions and is critical in identifying minute levels of impurities or contamination by undesirable substances in wateIn transformer-type inductive conductivity sensors, losses are typically manifested as thermal energy, resulting in a temperature increase that has a deleterious effect on the sensor’s conductivity measurements. This paper presents an analytical solution for the losses in transformer-type inductive conductivity sensors. This is achieved by analyzing their extended equivalent circuit and incorporating an improved Steinmetz formula. The losses in transformer-type inductive conductivity sensors made of various ferromagnetic materials were calculated, and the loss data were compared with results obtained from finite element method (FEM) simulations. The findings indicate a maximum deviation of $4.53 \%$ between the analytical and simulation methods, thereby affirming the accuracy and reliability of the proposed loss calculation method. It can be applied to the optimized design of conductivity sensors in the cooling system of HVDC, demonstrating significant potential for application.

articleTitle: Key Parameters Affecting the Transient Characteristics of Active Distribution Networks Under Large Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Mastering the key parameters affecting the transient characteristics of active distribution networks is essential for establishing accurate equivalent models of active distribution networks and studying the impact of distributed generation on the power grid. This paper proposes a comprehensive evaluation index and extracts the key parameters within active distribution networks based on the proposed index. Firstly, a detailed electromagnetic model of an actual active distribution network is established, and the impacts of grid strength and unit capacity on the external characteristics of active distribution networks are analyzed. Then, based on the phase characteristics of the external features of active distribution networks, a comprehensive evaluation index is proposed. The index calculation is performed separately for grid strength, unit capacity, and unit parameters, obtaining the key parameters affecting the external characteristics of active distribution networks.

articleTitle: Research on MEC and LoRa-based scheme for processing state information of equipment in converter station
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Aiming at the status quo of low efficiency of traditional manual inspection to collect equipment state information and difficult to deeply analyse and predict equipment operation state in China’s converter stations, a converter station equipment operation state information processing scheme based on mobile edge computing and LoRa communication is proposed. Firstly, the advantages of edge computing and LoRa technology are analyzed, and the former is integrated into a handheld mobile terminal with the characteristics of IOT sensing and APP function for collecting the operating state information of the inspected equipment; secondly, LoRa communication is used to realize the collection of the information of the inspected equipment in the front-end, and 4G is used to realize the information interaction and communication scheme between the front-end and the back-end system; lastly, a new solution for collecting equipment operating state information is proposed through the examples and the comparison with the currently used manual collection of equipment operating state information. Finally, the superiority and feasibility of the given scheme are verified through example demonstration and comparison with the commonly used manual scheme for collecting equipment operation status information.

articleTitle: A Novel Dual-Switch Capacitor Series DC Transformer Topology with Faults and Inrush Current Suppression
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: DC transformer is important interface between multi terminal flexible DC distribution networks, DC loads, and DC microgrids. This paper proposes a topology structure of a dual switched capacitor series DC transformer suitable for multi terminal flexible DC distribution networks. When a short circuit fault occurs on the medium voltage DC side, the dual switched capacitor series module is locked to block the external discharge of the capacitor, quickly cut off the fault, and restore operation quickly. When the instantaneous blocking of communication faults causes a step like fluctuation in the power flow of each port, the power flow is prone to flow into the DC transformer with low impedance, triggering the protection shutdown. At this time, the dual switch capacitor series module blocking is used to prevent external surge and improve the reliability of the system. Compared to the conventional full-bridge + DAB topology, the proposed topology eliminates two switching tubes. Additionally, it offers advantages such as fault current suppression, inrush current suppression, higher efficiency, and reduced economic costs. Finally, the simulation and actual large-scale engineering test results verified the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed method, which has practical value in engineering.

Author Keywords: high and medium dc power system

articleTitle: Analysis of the influence of voltage measurement anomalies on the DC side of UHVDC flexible converter stations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: This article takes the valve-side DC voltage transformer measurement anomalies which occurred in UHVDC flexible converter station. Through RTDS simulation, it has been demonstrated that the abnormality in valve-side DC voltage measurement has an impact on control and protection. The abnormal appearance when the DC voltage transformer secondary voltage dividing plate fail, under different types of conditions were analyzed, It is verified by strip inspection of the resistance, The paper researched and summarized this kind of problems, providing a reference for similar fault points in UHVDC projects.

articleTitle: Study on Coherent Radiation Directivity Algorithm for Power Capacitor Tower in HVDC Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: AC filters are one of the main sources of noise in DC converter stations. To control the noise in converter stations, the key is to reduce the noise level of AC filter capacitors. At present, there are various low-noise AC filter capacitors on the market, but the noise reduction effect of capacitors provided by different manufacturers varies greatly. Due to the lack of unified methods for measuring capacitor noise, the measurement results are not comparable, which poses difficulties for the selection of AC filtering capacitors. This article is based on a specialized multi harmonic current loading circuit for measuring capacitor noise, and studies the numerical calculation method of noise directionality. It also proposes a simulation calculation method for a typical converter station capacitor tower model.

articleTitle: Analysis of the action of converter bridge differential protection caused by magnetizing inrush current of converter transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: In the event of a failure in the converter transformer protection system during the operation of the converter station, there is a risk to the safety of the equipment, as well as disruption to the smooth operation of the system and the uninterrupted supply of power. This issue pertains to the professional concepts of a DC transmission system and a converter station. The DC protection system is configured with three sets of converter bridge differential protection ($87 \mathrm{CBY} / 87 \mathrm{CBD}$), of which B and C sets of converter bridge differential protection (87CBY/87CBD) auctioned. According to the waveform of the fault recording system, the accident process was analyzed, and combined with Simulink simulation verification, the analysis showed that the differential current of $Y / \Delta$ converter transformer was caused by a large magnetizing inrush current, which met the differential protection criterion of B and C converter bridge, so as to make the protection action.

articleTitle: Power Balance Optimization Modulation Strategy for Hybrid Cascaded H-Bridge Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The traditional modulation strategies based on hybrid cascade H -bridge inverters frequently integrate two modulation approaches: step-wave modulation and carrier cascade modulation. To address the power imbalance issue when the traditional modulation strategy is implemented in the hybrid cascade 11-level inverter with a DC voltage ratio of $1: 2: 2$, an enhanced hybrid modulation strategy is put forward. This strategy is optimized in all operational modes of the units at all levels, and the optimal working mode switching path is established, ensuring that the output voltage polarity of the high and low voltage units remains consistent throughout the output cycle and fulfilling the prerequisite of no current inversion. The dual high-voltage units adopt high-frequency PWM (pulse width modulation)wave modulation, and the output voltage waveforms are complementary and symmetrical, thereby achieving self-balancing of the output power. The simulation and experimental results demonstrate that this strategy can eliminate the current backfilling phenomenon and realize the power balance among high voltage units.

articleTitle: DC Microgrid Flexible Interconnection Switch and Its Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The four-switch buck-boost converter is adopted as the flexible interconnection switch of DC microgrid, due to its characteristics such as the same polarity of input and output, low switch voltage stress, ability to boost and buck, and fault isolation. In order to realize the function of energy interaction between DC microgrids, a primary regulation droop control strategy is designed. By detecting the magnitude of the bus voltages at both ends, the magnitude and direction of the trend dispatch are calculated according to the set droop curve. On the basis of the above droop curve, a left-right shift function of the droop curve is introduced. When the bus voltages on both sides of the interconnecting switch are inconsistent, the level-shift function is utilized to maintain the bus voltages on both sides within the normal operating range. The proposed scheme and control strategy are validated through simulation and experiments, demonstrating their feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of Inlet Valve Water Temperature in Flexible DC Valve Cooling System Based on VMD-DF
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: To achieve intelligent prediction of the inlet water temperature of the flexible DC converter valve cooling system, a prediction model combining VMD and DF algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the inlet water temperature signal is collected and processed. Then, it is decomposed by VMD to obtain multiple modal components and residual signals. Secondly, the improved DF algorithm is used to predict the decomposed subsignals and residual signals. Finally, all the prediction results are superimposed and reconstructed. The experimental results show that the proposed method has significantly reduced prediction error and is superior to the current mainstream models.

articleTitle: Digital management tool of DC maintenance equipment based on RPA robot and Wieger table
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: This paper introduces in detail the implementation of digital management system based on RPA robot technology and Wieger table in the management system of DC maintenance equipment. This paper first analyzes the limitations of traditional management methods and the necessity of digital system, and then details the specific application of RPA technology in automatic data acquisition, including the cooperation with system developers to obtain API interface and design automation script. Wieger tables are used for data statistics and analysis to optimize data processing and decision support. It also discusses the effects of digital management system implementation, including improving data accuracy, reducing labor costs and improving operational efficiency. Prospective improvements to the system are also widely discussed to ensure its reliability and long-term benefits.

articleTitle: Credibility Assessment of Low-voltage Topology Changes Detection Based on Data Quality Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: A clear low-voltage topological relationship is the basis of low-voltage DC operation and maintenance. Without prior knowledge of the topology, the accuracy of the topological change detection method is hard to be quantified. Therefore, from the data quality perspective, a credibility assessment method of the data-driven low-voltage topology changes detection is proposed. Firstly, the influence mechanism of data quality on each link of the topological change detection method is analyzed, which provides the basis for the subsequent index system and evaluation method. Secondly, from the three dimensions of data missing, data error and data difference, a multi-dimensional and multi-level station data quality evaluation index system including 6 sub-items such as the proportion of missing measurement points is constructed to quantify data quality characteristics. Then, the influence degree and weight value of each index were clarified through sensitivity analysis, and the credibility assessment model is proposed to evaluate the reliability of the perception results of the topological changes of the station. Finally, the proposed assessment method is verified on the low-voltage station area of 15 users as an example.

articleTitle: Selective Detuning Energy Information Integration Method for DC Microgrid DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The integration of energy information refers to the synchronous transmission of information while transmitting power by the traditional power electronic converter. Since the fixed Frequency carrier used when no information is transmitted will produce harmonics related to it, which will cause great harm to the equipment, in order to avoid the influence of the harmonics of fixed frequency and frequency doubling when no information is transmitted, this paper proposes Binary Frequency Shift Keying with specific subharmonic elimination. 2FSK) Energy information integration method, using specific tuned carrier as power carrier when no information is transmitted; When transmitting information, the carrier of its corresponding frequency is switched according to the digital signal 0 or 1 for data transmission, and the information transmission rate is as high as 20kbit/s. In the demodulation part, the paper samples the extreme value points and sets the threshold to demodulate. This method can quickly complete the sampling calculation and demodulate the original data, and reduce the system delay time. Finally, the feasibility of the above method is verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: The Research on High Voltage Test Technology of ± 800kV High-end valve side bushing in Kunliulong Flexible HVDC Project
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Power frequency withstand voltage band partial discharge test, lightning impulse test, partial discharge interference investigation, and impulse waveform modulation of the ± 800kV high-end valve side bushing of Kunliulong flexible DC transmission project are described in detail in this article. In the investigation of partial discharge interference, interference sources such as high-voltage end metal foreigh body dischare, oil bubble discharge, and suspended metal dischare were successfully found. And the characteristics of bubble discharge and metal suspension discharge were analyzed. In the impulse waveform modulation, the copper foil is used as the connecting wire and the wiring method is changed to solve the problem of difficulty in wave modulation caused by the “too large” of the bushing capacitance and the long test loop.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation and Experimental Research on Water Distribution for Compact Converter Valve Module
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The uniformity of water distribution in the converter valve cooling system is one of the important factors affecting the safe and reliable operation of the converter valve. The parallel water channel layout of the converter valve module can ensure that each cooled component has a good cooling effect, and the pipeline layout is relatively simple, but the uneven flow distribution in the parallel pipeline will affect the heat dissipation effect of the component. Aiming at the structure of a compact converter valve module, CFX numerical simulation is used to analyse the flow distribution of double radiator series branches, single radiator branch and reactor branches, and to guide the parameter configuration of single radiator branch damping tube. Meanwhile the test and simulation results are compared and analysed to verify the feasibility of the simulation method. And the radiator table temperature measurement test is carried out on the synthetic circuit to calibrate the thyristor junction temperature and meet the temperature operation requirements, which verifies the reliability of the water distribution method. It provides a reliable design verification method for the cooling system water distribution problem of water-cooled primary equipment such as flow-exchange valve.

articleTitle: Research on Engineering Design of AC-DC Hybrid Distribution Network for the Integration of New Generation and Load
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: With the large-scale integration of renewable energy sources and electric vehicles, traditional AC distribution networks face challenges in meeting regulatory requirements. AC-DC hybrid distribution systems, offering advantages such as large capacity, low losses, and ease of integrating new power sources and loads, are increasingly applied in distribution grids. In this study, we evaluate the design of an AC-DC hybrid distribution network based on the demonstration project in Hubei Province. Based on the four-port power electronic transformer, the system architecture and main wiring mode are designed. The operation mode of the system is preliminarily designed, and the main technical requirements of the electrical primary and secondary are determined. The overcurrent and overvoltage characteristics of the system are simulated and analyzed, and the overcurrent tolerance requirements of the system are proposed. This research introduces new technological solutions and provides simulation validation, offering valuable reference points for future projects.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Monitoring Terminal Based on Electric Power Maintenance Safety Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: In view of the current situation of the rapid increase of electric power maintenance objects and the lack of monitoring means in the operation site, especially in remote areas, An intelligent monitoring terminal is designed, which is suitable for the safety operation of power maintenance site.Firstly, the safety operation measures and existing problems of current electric power maintenance are analyzed. Secondly, based on the diversification of electric power maintenance scenarios, The function, overall structure, power supply and communication scheme of the intelligent monitoring terminal are designed. And the specific monitoring strategy of the terminal is studied;Finally, the intelligent monitoring terminal designed in this paper is compared with the video surveillance system which has been applied at present.The intelligent monitoring terminal designed in this paper is easy to carry and deploy, fast to warn, and can repair the power anytime and anywhere without relying on external power supply.Operation monitoring has a wider range of practical applications.

articleTitle: Research on the solution of the abnormality of DC protection LAN network communication between converter station based on TDC platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The DC protection inter-station LAN network communication of the TDC platform adopts a dual LAN network structure, that is, the bipolar DC protection of the station is connected to the inter-station LAN1 and LAN2 switches to form a communication cross-redundant structure, and is sent to the opposite station through the protection interstation communication router. The station bipolar DC protection then retains the required information as needed and discards the redundant information. This paper analyzes a maloperation event of DC metal loop longitudinal differential protection caused by inter-station communication structure defects in Puer-Qiaoxiang HVDC, and proposes three optimization measures: library file upgrade, single LAN operation and adding redundant communication channels, and abnormal data detection logic block. The feasibility is verified on site, which solves the problem of abnormal communication between DC protection stations under TDC platform, and improves the stability and safety of DC protection operation.

articleTitle: LoRa Terminal Network Access Authentication Technology Based on Radio Frequency Fingerprint
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: LoRa, as a low-power wide area network communication technology, is currently widely used in various IoT scenarios. However, the access authentication mechanism during LoRa communication is not perfect and is vulnerable to malicious attacks such as identity forgery. In order to solve the problem that the LoRa access authentication mechanism is vulnerable to attack, this article uses LoRa radio frequency fingerprint as the unique identification information of LoRa devices to distinguish and identify LoRa devices. Since the radio frequency fingerprint characteristics reflect the inherent hardware characteristics of the wireless transmitter, it has good security and reliability. Combining the characteristics of LoRa technology, this paper proposes a radio frequency fingerprint extraction method based on I/Q offset and a radio frequency fingerprint extraction method based on carrier frequency offset. The former uses the phase and amplitude information in the received radio signal to extract the LoRa radio frequency fingerprint by calculating the I/Q offset of the signal; the latter uses the carrier frequency offset information in the received radio signal to calculate the signal’s I/Q offset. Frequency offset value to extract LoRa radio frequency fingerprint. In the experimental part, we selected multiple LoRa devices to emit the same data, and used the two methods proposed above to extract the RF fingerprints of all the devices. Experimental results show that our method can clearly distinguish the differences between different devices, and can improve the accuracy and security of LoRa terminal network access authentication.

articleTitle: Hydrogen Energy Storage-based DC Energy Hub for Regenerative Braking Energy Utilization in Electrified Railways
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: This paper presents a hydrogen energy storage-based DC energy hub for the utilization of regenerative braking energy (RBE) in electrified railways. The proposed system features a back-to-back converter topology that integrates the hydrogen energy storage system at the DC bus. The operation principle of the proposed system, including RBE utilization and power quality enhancement, is analyzed. To ensure the effective operation of the proposed hydrogen energy storage-based DC energy hub under complex operational conditions of railway power supply system, a hierarchical control strategy is then developed to achieve power management and converter control. Finally, the performance and effectiveness of the proposed system are validated through comprehensive simulation under different load conditions of railway power supply system.

articleTitle: Active Power Limitation of Windfarm Generation Transmitted Through MMC-HVDC Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: High-voltage DC systems based on modular multilevel converters (MMC-HVDC systems) are suitable for integrating power generation of renewable energy. However, once the transmission power exceeds the limitation, the system becomes unstable. This paper puts forward a way to figure out the power limitation. First, the equivalent circuit of sending-end system, which consists of renewable energy, the grid-connected inverter as well as the sending-end MMC, is established. Then, the power of the sending-system is calculated, and the maximum value of active power can be obtained. In addition, the qualitative explanation of the system instability mechanism is provided when the active power goes beyond the limitation. Finally, the transmission of renewable energy via modular multilevel converters (MMC-HVDC systems) is constructed on the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform. The calculation value of active power limitation is close to the simulation value, indicating the correctness of the analysis and calculation in this paper.

articleTitle: The Research on Key Technologies of Partial Discharge Measurement in Suspended Wall Bushing for EHV and UHV DC Projects
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: DC wall bushing is one of the key equipment in EHV and UHV DC transmission projects. As an effective means to detect insulation defects in the early stage, partial discharge measurement is widely used in the insulation defect detection of DC wall bushing. However, under the standard requirements of high voltage and low partial discharge, it is a difficult task to strictly suppress the interference signal of partial discharge in the testing environment. In this paper, relying on the partial discharge measurement test of wall bushing under suspension mode, the influence of the material selection, installation angle and diameter of the insulated diagonal rod on the electric field distribution is studied through simulation calculation. Based on the research results, the design optimization scheme of the insulated diagonal rod is completed, and the research results are finally verified in the practical engineering application.

articleTitle: Advanced Wideband-frequency Grid Impedance Measurement Utilizing MMC-HVDC Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The increasing integration of offshore wind farms via modular multilevel converter (MMC) based high voltage direct current (HVDC) introduces multi-timescale and multi-frequency dynamics within the alternating current (AC) grid. An accurate grid impedance model across a broad frequency range is essential for power system analysis. The perturbation-based impedance measurement method offers the advantage of not relying on internal parameters of all system components. Given that not all modulation capacity of MMCs is utilized, this paper proposes a novel grid impedance measurement method that leverages the remaining modulation capability of MMCs to inject perturbations into the power grid under both active-reactive power (P-Q) control, representing grid-following control, and AC voltage-frequency (V-F) control, representing grid-forming control, thereby obtaining the system’s impedance-frequency characteristics. The proposed method is validated through strong and weak (or islanded) grid models in MATLAB/Simulink, considering properties of both distributed and nominal π equivalent line models. The results show that the proposed method can effectively measure the wideband-frequency characteristics of grid impedance without requiring additional high-cost equipment, while maintaining stable operation of the system.

articleTitle: Analysis and Treatment of Frequent Pressure Failures in the AC Filter Field Circuit Breakers of UHV Converter Stations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The structure and working principle of the HMB-8 hydraulic disc spring mechanism are elaborated. An analysis and research have been conducted on the oil circuit system and sealing structure of the HMB-8 hydraulic disc spring mechanism. An in-depth analysis of different internal leakage fault phenomena has been carried out, and methods for fault point diagnosis and countermeasures have been proposed. The correctness and effectiveness of the internal leakage diagnosis method have been verified through the inspection and handling of two internal leakage faults in the HMB-8 operating mechanism.

articleTitle: LCC-MMC HVDC Line Pilot Protection Based on U-Q Characteristic Curve
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Hybrid high-voltage DC systems are gradually becoming the main form of DC engineering. The distributed capacitance effect of long-distance DC lines is very obvious, which leads to the fact that the existing pilot protection schemes need a long enough rectification delay to avoid false operation. This article proposes a pilot protection principle based on U-Q transient characteristics. The U-Q characteristic of the line is a regular linear spiral characteristic under normal operation and external fault (EF) condition. For internal fault (IF), the transient U-Q characteristic of the transmission lines are nonlinear. Based on this difference in characteristics, A pilot protection scheme will be developed on the basis of transient U Q characteristics. The proposed scheme is less computationally intensive and is not constrained by system parameters. The model is constructed in PSCAD/EMTDC and a large number of simulations are carried out to test the speed and stability of the proposed scheme. The simulations under different conditions show that the proposed scheme can act quickly and reliably and has good robustness to high resistance faults.

articleTitle: Research on the abnormal discharge law of HVDC transmission converter valve and its improvement measures
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of abnormal discharge of HVDC converter valve, this paper takes ± 500kV valve tower as the research object, builds the electric field simulation analysis model of converter valve tower, solves the electric field distribution of converter valve shielding system and various components under insulation type test condition and operation conditions and determines the uneven position of converter valve electric field distribution. On this basis, this paper proposed improvement measures and verified their effectiveness through high-voltage tests.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Reasons for the Failed 10 kV MOA Based on Impulse Aging and Power Frequency Aging Tests
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Due to lightning strikes and prolonged power frequency voltage exposure, frequent failures and defects caused by the decommissioning of 10 kV surge arresters in the power grid severely affect the reliability and stability of power supply. Therefore, this study selects $\mathbf{Z n O}$ varistor samples from mainstream 10 kV arrester manufacturers to conduct impulse aging tests and power frequency aging tests in order to investigate the reasons behind the failure and decommissioning of 10 kV arresters. During the tests, the following parameters were measured: the positive/negative $D C$ reference voltage $\left(U_{1 \mathrm{~mA}}\right)$, the leakage current at 0.75 times $U_{1 \mathrm{~mA}}$ under positive/negative voltage, the resistive current under continuous operating voltage, and its harmonic characteristics. Finally, a comparative analysis of the electrical performance trends and differences in failure modes of the samples under the two tests was made. The results show that under impulse aging tests, the performance of the ZnO varistors deteriorated continuously, leading to failure modes such as cracking and pinhole defects. However, in power frequency aging tests, the performance of the ZnO varistors was improved, and no failure modes were observed. Based on these findings, it is speculated that the failures and decommissioning of 10 kV surge arresters are mainly caused by lightning impulses. Future research should focus on enhancing the impulse withstand capability of $\mathbf{Z n O}$ varistors in 10 kV surge arresters.

articleTitle: Analysis of Resource Configuration for Power Quality Control in Distribution Network with High Proportion Distributed PV
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: With the promotion of “peak carbon dioxide emissions and carbon neutrality”, photovoltaic (PV) generation has seen a recorded increase in a decade. It has become an inevitable trend for masses of PV generation to be integrated into distributed power systems. Different from conventional fossil-based generation, PV generation is connected to the distributed power system through grid-connected converters (GCCs), having fast-adjusting ability but being low-inertia and nonlinear, which leads to numerous power quality issues that have emerged in distribution networks. In this paper, a power quality resource configuration method for distribution power systems with a high proportion of distributed PV access is proposed to reduce the power quality influence caused by PV generation integration. Firstly, the principle of PV generation’s influence on the power quality of the distribution power system is analyzed, especially in voltage deviation. Based on the analysis and current research on resource configuration, a novel power quality resource configuration method is proposed. Finally, a real distribution power system with high-penetrated distributed PV is adopted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The result indicates that the proposed power quality resource configuration method could meet the needs of the actual distribution network scenario.

articleTitle: Fault identification method for flexible HVDC line based on Euclidean similarity calculation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: To solve the problems of insufficient ability to withstand transition resistance of existing travelling wave (TW) protection, a fault identification method for flexible HVDC transmission line based on Euclidean similarity calculation is proposed. Through detailed analysis of the 1 -mode voltage backwards TW, it can be concluded that the current-limiting reactor (CLR) will affect the variation characteristics of initial travelling wave (ITW). Therefore, this paper takes the change rate waveforms of line-mode voltage ITW of typical internal and external faults as the reference waveforms, and calculates the Euclidean similarity between the fault waveform and the reference waveforms to identify faults, and reduces the influence of transition resistance with the help of normalization. The principle of the method is simple, and the simulation results show that the proposed method can reliably identify the faults, with high sensitivity and selectivity.

articleTitle: Design of flexible HVDC control system based on MMC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) can be used as an important component of ultra-high voltage flexible DC transmission to achieve long-distance DC transmission, island power supply and other important areas of power supply. During the transition between active and passive networks in the DC transmission grid, issues such as active power imbalance and AC voltage oscillations can lead to instability. To address these challenges, a control strategy for active/passive network switching based on the Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) is introduced. This strategy enhances external power and phase angle control, mitigates the instantaneous active power imbalance during the switch, and ensures a seamless transition in the DC power grid. A three-phase MMC simulation model is developed in PSCAD/EMTDC to test the proposed control strategy. The simulation outcomes demonstrate that the system operates stably during active, passive, and switching phases, thereby validating the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Principle Analysis and Optimization Strategy for Tripping Self-holding Circuit in the Last Breaker Protection of AC Filters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The last breaker protection of AC filters is a crucial protection arrangement in Ultra-High Voltage Direct Current (UHVDC) transmission systems. However, in some DC projects following Siemens technical route, the logic for judging the last breaker of AC filters only considers the state of other circuit breakers in the AC filter bay series, leading to potential safety hazards of forming the tripping self-holding circuit when the last breaker protection of AC filters actuates. Therefore, this paper reviews the actual secondary wiring of the protection trip outlet circuit, analyzes the principle behind the occurrence of the tripping self-holding circuit, and proposes a highly practical field operation and maintenance optimization strategy to disconnect the circuit by switching off the links based on the characteristic electrical quantities of the circuit. Additionally, to address the deficiencies in the existing judgment logic, this paper proposes an optimized strategy for logical judgment of the last breaker of AC filters, involving the states of all series breaker intervals. This optimization strategy fundamentally eliminates the safety hazards associated with the tripping self-holding circuit, which is logically complete, highly applicable and requires no modifications to the hardware of the on-site protection circuit.

Author Keywords: Last Breaker Protection of AC Filter
States of all series breaker intervals

articleTitle: Switching Strategy And Fault Analysis Of Earth Metal Loop For Hybrid Three-terminal HVDC Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Multi-terminal hybrid flexible DC power transmission is an important development direction of DC power transmission in China. Firstly, the structure of the threeterminal HVDC system, the structure of the three-terminal earth loop and the metal loop are modeled. Then the conversion steps and differences between conventional DC and flexible DC earth/metal loop are analyzed. Finally, this paper studies the possible ground faults and fault characteristics in the threeterminal earth metal return line conversion process, points out the influence of the metal return line grounding fault on the three-terminal hybrid HVDC system, and gives the corresponding protection configuration according to the fault types.

Author Keywords: Three terminal direct current transmission system

articleTitle: Single-Line-to-Ground Fault Section Location for Multi-Terminal DC Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Accurate and reliable identification of single-line-to-ground (SLG) faults is critical to ensuring the safe and stable operation of multi-terminal DC (MTDC) distribution networks. This paper proposes a novel MMC-based control strategy for SLG fault isolation and fault section location, which identifies the fault section while limiting the fault current. First, an improved configuration of the modular multilevel converter’s (MMC’s) converter transformer is proposed to provide a grounded neutral point for the MMC. Second, a zero-sequence current isolation strategy is designed to limit the fault current during SLG faults. Further, a non-power-frequency zerosequence current injection strategy is proposed. After a fault occurs, the MMCs at each terminal inject detection signals with orthogonal frequencies into the network to locate the fault section. A three-terminal DC distribution network model is built in PSCAD/EMTDC, and the proposed control strategy and fault identification scheme are added to the model. Simulation results proved that during an SLG fault, the fault current is limited to below 10 A, and the faulted section can be accurately located even with a fault transition resistance as high as $500 \Omega$.

articleTitle: Analysis on Current Control Strategy of Yunnan-Guizhou Interconnection Project
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: Yunnan-Guizhou Interconnection Project is the first ± 500 kV DC project in the world.By constructing the transmission channel from Luquan converter station in Yunnan, Gaopo converter station in Guizhou and Zhaoqing converter station in Guangdong, The flexible power transmission between Yunnan, Guizhou and Guangdong has been realized.Correspondingly, the function of its control and protection system also meets the requirements of power transmission under different working conditions of three-terminal operation. The control system realizes the angle control by adjusting the current reference value, and then realizes the power control.Therefore, the determination of the current reference value is one of the core functions of the control system. According to the actual situation of DC three-terminal operation, this paper combs the current control logic, that is, the transformation process of current reference value, with reference to the control software.Describe which functions affect the current reference and how.

articleTitle: Multi-level Encapsulated U-type Unit Inverter Energy-Information Integration Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of complex information transfer during the operation of multilevel Packed U-cell (PUC) inverters, a method for integrating energy information of multilevel Packed U-cell inverters is proposed. The method takes the multilevel encapsulated U-cell inverter as the research object; the data carrier is superimposed on the sinusoidal modulating waveform as a perturbation through the two-carrier binary frequency shift keying (2FSK) method, and the data information is superimposed on the pulse-width modulation (PWM) signal, which is used in the transmission of the switching signal, and in the transmission of the switching signal. signal, in the transfer of switching signals at the same time can realize the transfer of information, to achieve energy information integration. In this paper, the simulation model of multilevel PUC inverter is constructed, and the power/data dual-carrier modulation is adopted to superimpose the data signal in the form of perturbation on the power carrier, which makes it possible to transmit information while sending out the switching signal. The demodulation method of peak detection is adopted at the load end, and the demodulated data signal is compared with the data signal transmitted at the start end to verify the feasibility of the proposed method. This method enables the multilevel PUC inverter to realize power conversion and data conversion at the same time, and realizes the intelligence of the multilevel inverter.

articleTitle: A Magnetic Coupling Mechanical DC Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
abstract: The modern DC distribution system has become a key component of the new power system, and DC circuit breakers are the key to cutting off fault currents and ensuring stable system operation. This article conducts topology research, simulation analysis, prototype development, and experimental verification of mechanical DC circuit breakers based on magnetic coupling technology. Firstly, a magnetic coupling mechanical DC circuit breaker breaking scheme is proposed, and its topology and operation principle are given. Furthermore, design the magnetic coupling current transfer module, DC fast mechanical switch, and overall structure of the prototype. Finally, a $10 \mathrm{kV} / 2 \mathrm{kA}$ DC circuit breaker was successfully developed and subjected to breaking tests. The test results showed that the mechanical DC circuit breaker meets the requirement of breaking 2000A within 2 ms.

articleTitle: A zero crossing protection method for DC distribution network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on DC Technologies and Systems (DCTS)
